text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seems to have made<n>a strong
impression in her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer. Are you still feeling<n>nervous?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Wonderful. ♪ The first step has<n>been taken...
yes?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After packing up our things to head<n>back, we step
outside only to be<n>immediately approached by a
waiting<n>figure.

Excuse me, Grass Wonder! May I<n>ask you a few
quick questions?
Oh, certainly. Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Then let me start by<n>congratulating you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You displayed amazing potential in<n>your debut race!
Your running was a<n>sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to receive such praise.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, trust me, I've still got<n>goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder they call you the next
Maruzensky—you really are the<n>Beast's
Successor!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though the reporter's eyes are alight<n>with
excitement, I feel like they're<n>seeing too much of
Maruzensky and<n>not enough of Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder herself must be<n>feeling this
dissonance even more<n>acutely.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Allow me.
I try to step in, but Grass Wonder cuts<n>me off.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Too excited to notice the tension in<n>the air, the
reporter tries to press<n>onward with the interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So, what's in your racing schedule<n>going forward?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If you have anything planned, I'd love<n>to know
what race we'll be seeing<n>you in next!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, I was just about to discuss<n>that very topic
with my trainer.
So then, Trainer, is now a good time?
choice_data_list: Do you have a race in mind?
Do you have a race in mind?

text_block_list.text: Yes, my heart is set on one in<n>particular.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Allow me to race in the Asahi Hai<n>Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai F.S. is well-known to<n>determine the
top junior-year runner,<n>so it sounds like a perfect
objective<n>for her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But there's just one problem...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Did I hear that right?! The Asahi Hai<n>F.S.?! That's...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That's the race where Maruzensky<n>set a new
record back in her junior<n>year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And now you want to run in it next?!
Yes, so long as I receive my trainer's<n>permission.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As long as it wouldn't put<n>unreasonable strain on
her schedule,<n>I'd intended to approve any race she
might name.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: But this...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now this is a scoop! "The Successor<n>Aims for the
Junior Crown!" Yep, this<n>going on the front page!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your time and<n>the big news!
Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Please be careful on your way<n>home.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then... just to make sure.

Trainer, may I set the Asahi Hai F.S.<n>as my next
race goal?
choice_data_list: Are you sure this is what you want?
Are you sure this is what you want?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's performance in the<n>Asahi Hai F.S.
left a mark on the<n>racing world that still burns
vividly.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
People are already calling Grass<n>Wonder the next
Maruzensky. If she<n>makes this her next big race...
choice_data_list: It'll invite more comparison than ever.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I have to enter.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The nickname has already spread, so<n>there's no
escaping it now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have no intention of<n>running from it
anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the comparisons, I say. I'll<n>take this
chance to prove myself once<n>and for all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My running is one of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So... I'll ask one more time.

Do I have your permission to run in<n>the Asahi Hai
F.S.?
choice_data_list: Let's show the world what you can do!
Let's show the world what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then let's begin training right away. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Grass Wonder's next<n>goal is
decided: the Asahi Hai<n>Futurity Stakes!
